meta.title: Parent-Child Family Camp in Dagestan | MKR
meta.description: Train as a family in Dagestan. Parent and child 8-17 side by side on the mat. Adapted program, public family rates, specialized coaching.

hero.label: AS A FAMILY
hero.title:
TRAIN
AS A FAMILY.
hero.subtitle: Parent and child 8-17 side by side on the mat. An experience that gets passed down.

cinematic.alt: Father and son side by side on the mat at MKR camp, generational transmission
cinematic.label: HERITAGE
cinematic.title:
HERITAGE
GETS PASSED DOWN
cinematic.tagline: In Dagestan, wrestling has been a family affair for generations. You step into that tradition with your child.

principe.label: THE PRINCIPLE
principe.title: ONE CAMP, TWO EXPERIENCES
principe.p1: You attend the camp as an adult (Wrestling or MMA sessions at 10:30 / 11:00 and 17:30 / 18:00). Your child follows the youth wrestling program in parallel (10:30 and 17:30, specialized coaching). You meet up for meals, excursions, and free time.
principe.p2: MKR handles everything: Russian visa, domestic flight Istanbul-Makhachkala, transfers, family accommodation, 2 meals per day, coaching by experienced local coaches. You only organize the flight to Istanbul, then you grab your bag and your child's.
principe.p3_suffix: : children 8-17 must always be accompanied by a parent participating in the camp. No standalone child enrollment.
principe.img_alt: Young wrestlers lined up on the mat, Dagestani wrestling school

parent_obligatoire.title: Parent required
parent_obligatoire.desc: Child 8-17 always accompanied by a participating parent. A single registration funnel for the whole family.

programme_adapte.title: Adapted program
programme_adapte.desc: Parent in the adult sessions (Wrestling or MMA), child in the youth wrestling sessions at 10:30 and 17:30. You meet up for meals and excursions.

coach_jeunesse.title: Dedicated youth coach
coach_jeunesse.desc: A coach trained in youth pedagogy leads the children's sessions. Ratio 1 coach per 5 children maximum.

hebergement_famille.title: Family accommodation
hebergement_famille.desc: Private room for the family (subject to availability). Communal meals with other families and solo athletes.

securite.img_alt: Young wrestlers in controlled sparring under coach supervision
securite.label: SAFE FRAMEWORK
securite.title:
YOUR CHILD IS
IN GOOD HANDS
securite.intro: No KO allowed, strictly controlled sparring, permanent supervision. Techniques are taught progressively by a trained youth coach. The goal: pass on the Caucasus fundamentals in an age-appropriate framework.

checks.suffix: at the end of every session

securite.quote: "We were hesitant about bringing the kids. The youth coach hooked them from the very first session."

karim.name: Karim D.
karim.quote: My son came back transformed. More disciplined, more confident. And he learned things no coach in France would have shown him. We're going back next year, as a family.

marc.name: Marc T.
marc.quote: At 16, my son was at the age where you often lose teenagers. The camp gave him back the sense of effort, respect, and grit. For me at the same time, it was a total reset.

step1.title: Choose your format
step1.desc: Join one of our four official sessions (Summer 2026, Toussaint 2026, Winter 2027, Easter 2027) timed with school holidays, or a custom camp (your dates, 90 days minimum). In the form, check "Coming with your family?".

step2.title: List your children
step2.desc: Indicate the number of children (1 to 4) and their ages (between 8 and 17). The Family rate applies automatically: 1st child included, each additional child at the fixed rate {familyExtraChild1week}. The full pricing grid is higher up on the page.

step3.title: Approval and payment
step3.desc: Reply within 48h. If approved on the video call: full payment by bank transfer (bank details sent after the call), medical certificate for each member, preparation guide.

session.label: OFFICIAL SESSION
session.title: MKR Camp 2026
session.desc: Adult-only sessions, 4 windows timed with French-speaking school holidays. 30 spots per session (15 Wrestling + 15 MMA).

sur_mesure.label: CUSTOM
sur_mesure.title: Custom Camp
sur_mesure.desc: 1 to 4 adults (Solo, Duo, Trio, Quartet). Your dates, 90 days minimum. Combo Wrestling in Dagestan and MMA in Chechnya available.

clubs.label: CLUB AND GROUP
clubs.title: Clubs and Groups
clubs.desc: Dedicated camp for 5 to 20 people for your club. Block accommodation, group transfers, program adapted to the collective level. Custom quote.
